Life is short, but youth is even
shorter. And so use it while you got it. Unless you die, you can still get back
up and try again. And so for me, it took me realizing that the people who were
telling me what I need to do with my life had smaller goals than me. Because
if I told them what I really wanted, they'd be like, "Dude, get real." And so
you might have that, too. Some people in your life may be like, "Be realistic."
It's like, "I'm not trying to be realistic, man. I got one life. I'm
gonna die.
